summary: A toggle for an on/off setting, with its label, description and error beside it, taking part in forms.

label.note: Visible label next to the track and accessible name. Required: shadow DOM keeps an external <label for> from naming the inner input.

description.note: Help text under the label, in the accessible description.

error.note: Error message under the label. Setting it marks the field invalid and sets a customError validity (SB-0009).

size.note: Track 32x20px with a 16px thumb (default) or 24x16px with a 12px thumb (sm). Label typography does not change.

value.note: Submitted with the form while on; nothing is submitted while off.

checked.note: On or off. Not reflected: the attribute is the default that form reset restores.

required.note: Native required: the switch must be on for the form to submit (valueMissing). Adds an aria-hidden asterisk after the label.

disabled.note: Native disabled; dimmed; not focusable; not submitted. A <fieldset disabled> ancestor has the same effect without changing the attribute.

anatomy.name: field
anatomy.notes: Grid: the control in the first column; label, description and error in the second.

anatomy.name: control
anatomy.notes: The track: a pill sized by size, holding the native input and the thumb.

anatomy.name: input
anatomy.notes: Native <input type="checkbox" role="switch">, transparent and covering the track; receives focus, Space and validation.

anatomy.name: thumb
anatomy.notes: Round knob at the start when off and at the end when on (mirrored under :dir(rtl)); aria-hidden, pointer-events none.

anatomy.name: label
anatomy.notes: Native <label for> in the same shadow root; clicking it toggles.

anatomy.name: error
anatomy.notes: Persistent polite live region; text appears when invalid.

input.note: Each toggle. Native and composed, so it crosses the shadow boundary.

change.note: Toggle committed. Re-dispatched from the host because native change is not composed (NativeControl). The form value is already updated when it fires.

focus-visible.note: 3px solid ring around the track, following its pill radius (a translucent ring would fall under 3:1).

checked.note: Thumb slides to the end; the track fills with the checked color. The slide uses the transition tokens and is removed under prefers-reduced-motion.

invalid.trigger: error set, or required and off after blur or a submit attempt

disabled.trigger: disabled attribute or a disabled fieldset ancestor (:host(:disabled))

accessibility.accessibleNameSource: The label prop, through a native <label for> in the same shadow root.

formAssociation.note: FormAssociated + NativeControl mixins. formValue(): value while on, null while off. formReset(): checked back to the checked attribute. formStateRestore(): on when the restored state is the value. validationAnchor(): the inner input, so required gives the native valueMissing and its message, and reportValidity() focuses it. Disabled (own or fieldset) is not submitted. syncFormState() runs in the change handler, before change is re-dispatched. A <label for> pointing at the host toggles it (click forwarded to the inner input).

accessibility.targetSize: Track is 32x20px (default) or 24x16px (sm); the label next to it is part of the clickable row and the 12px gap satisfies the WCAG 2.5.8 spacing exception for sm.
accessibility.focusRingVisible: On keyboard focus of the input; 3px ring in switch.focus-ring.color around the track.
accessibility.missingNameWarning: Dev-only console warning, once, when label is empty (NativeControl).

keyboard.Tab: move focus to and from the switch
keyboard.Enter: submits the form (implicit submission; the inner input has no form owner in its shadow root, SB-0009). Does not toggle.

aria: role="switch" on the native checkbox; its checked state is exposed as aria-checked true/false by the browser
aria-describedby -> description and error ids (same root)
required: native required; the asterisk is aria-hidden
error: sets a customError validity, so the form blocks submission
no mixed state: a switch is on or off (WAI-ARIA switch role)
the thumb is aria-hidden decoration; the on/off state is not conveyed by color alone (thumb position)
announcements: on/off is announced natively on toggle
error text is announced once when it appears (persistent aria-live=polite region)

useCases.when: A single setting that is either on or off
useCases.use: sb-switch with a label naming the setting

useCases.when: The consequence of turning it on needs explaining
A dense settings list or toolbar
The setting must be on before the form can be sent
useCases.use: required, with error for a custom message

antiPatterns.pattern: A switch for a choice that is only recorded when a form is submitted, such as agreeing to terms
antiPatterns.why: A switch reads as a setting that takes effect at once; an agreement is a choice to confirm

antiPatterns.pattern: A switch whose label changes with its state ("On"/"Off")
antiPatterns.why: The state is already announced; the label names the setting
antiPatterns.alternative: A fixed label that names the setting

antiPatterns.pattern: Choosing one of several options with switches
antiPatterns.why: Switches are independent; nothing turns the others off

antiPatterns.pattern: A toolbar button that turns formatting on and off
antiPatterns.why: That is a pressed button, not a setting

drift.contract: label, description and error are props of Switch
drift.realization: the reference composes Field parts around Switch; shadow DOM requires them inside
the reference uses a light input fill that is under 3:1 (WCAG 1.4.11)

drift.contract: 32x20 and 24x16 from size.switch.* with a 2px inset
drift.realization: the reference track is 32x18.4 (default) and 24x14 (sm) with a 1px transparent border

drift.contract: thumb is color.background off and color.primary-foreground on, in both modes
drift.realization: the reference uses the foreground color for the off thumb in dark mode
not reflected: the attribute is the default restored by form reset

openQuestions.question: Contract content drafted with the contract-author skill (visual reference, WAI-ARIA APG)?
openQuestions.answer: Yes: APG switch pattern, label row beside the track, form behavior from the form-associated-controls rule.

openQuestions.question: Native <input type=checkbox role=switch>, or a <button role=switch> with aria-checked?
openQuestions.answer: Native checkbox with role=switch (SB-0007: native first). It gives Space, required/valueMissing, the validation message and NativeControl reuse for free; a button would re-implement all of them.

openQuestions.question: Does Enter toggle the switch (APG lists it as optional)?
openQuestions.recommendation: No; Enter submits the form, like Checkbox.
openQuestions.answer: No. Enter submits the form (SB-0009), as the native checkbox and sb-checkbox do; Space toggles.

openQuestions.question: Which sizes, and under which names?
openQuestions.recommendation: default and sm, as in the visual reference.
openQuestions.answer: size = default | sm (mapped to medium | small in spec/api.json aliases), from the existing size.switch.* semantic tokens. No lg.

openQuestions.question: Is checked reflected to an attribute?
openQuestions.answer: No. The attribute is the default that form reset restores (native defaultChecked); checked is a property.

openQuestions.question: Label before or after the control?
openQuestions.recommendation: After, like Checkbox and the visual reference.
openQuestions.answer: Control first, label after. A settings row with the switch at the end is a layout for Field or a kit, not a prop.

openQuestions.question: Add hide-label like Checkbox?
openQuestions.answer: Not in this version: the request is label, description, error and two sizes. Add it later if a settings layout needs a visually hidden label.
